system.description:
You conjure a suit of illusionary armor. This armor grants you a +1 bonus to your AC. If you would be the target of a Genjutsu attack, you instead treat this bonus as a +2.

If a creature manages to score a hit with a melee weapon or Taijutsu attack against you, you force them to make an Intelligence saving throw as you send back psychic feedback.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature immediately falls Prone and drops their weapon, if any after their attacks effects.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but their movement speed is also reduced to 0, until the end of their next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, you gain 5 DR against Psychic damage and a creature who fails their saving throw takes 2d6 psychic damage on a failed save or 4d6 on a critical failure. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you gain 10 DR against psychic damage and a creature who fails their saving throw takes 4d6 psychic damage on a failed save or 8d6 on a critical failure.
